articles.title: Veteran Journalist Jon Snow Reveals Alzheimer's Diagnosis, Turns His Final Investigation Into a Documentary
articles.summary: Jon Snow, who anchored Channel 4 News for 32 years, has Alzheimer's. He initially hid the diagnosis but is now speaking out to fight stigma. A new film follows his last big investigation — an environmental disaster in Zambia — while navigating life with the disease.

articles.title: A Flesh-Eating Parasite Returns to the U.S. After 60 Years, Threatening the Cattle Industry
articles.summary: The New World screwworm fly, whose larvae devour live flesh, has been found in a Texas calf — the first U.S. case since 1966. The pest, eradicated decades ago, is spreading north due to climate change and threatens the $113 billion cattle industry.

articles.title: Anthony Head, Beloved Star of Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Ted Lasso, Dies at 72
articles.summary: British actor Anthony Head, best known as Giles in Buffy and for roles in Ted Lasso and Merlin, has died from pneumonia complications. His daughters said he passed peacefully, surrounded by family. He was 72.
